coordination.label: OCHA
coordination.ocha_plan: Afghanistan Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan 2026 (HNRP)
coordination.note: HNRP (OCHA). A separate 2026 Response Plan for Afghan Returnees (US$529.2M, published by the UN Resident Coordinator's Office, IOM and the integrated RC/HC office named as contacts) exists; no UNHCR-led plan confirmed.

cwg_reliefweb.last_update_basis: latest document listed on the page (WFP Weekly Market Report, issue 291, posted 2026-04-17)
cwg_reliefweb.contacts_basis: Not on the ReliefWeb page. WFP co-lead and NGO co-lead (DRC) come from a closed 2020 WFP vacancy notice; IRC hosts a 'CVWG Co-chair Technical Coordinator (Afghan nationals only)' post, undated. Current seat-holders not confirmed.
cwg_reliefweb.note: Page has no contacts block, dashboard, minutes or updated stamp; listed documents are WFP market reports, not CVWG outputs.

cva_delivered_usd.note: US$152.7M reaching 16.6M people through CWG partners; page says late Q3 and Q4 submissions pending.

mpc_delivered_usd.note: Reported as MPC in HNRP 2026 CVA overview.

sectoral_cva_delivered_usd.note: No sectoral split stated in the HNRP section opened.

fsps.name: HesabPay
fsps.evidence: NRC e-cash pilot (USD170/month x3, Kandahar, 2024) via HesabPay; UNHCR page lists HesabPay prepaid cards (June 2025).

fsps.name: m-Hawala
fsps.evidence: UNHCR Afghanistan page lists m-Hawala as a mobile money platform used for digital cash since 2024.

fsps.name: Hawala agents (informal)
fsps.evidence: NRC explainer says humanitarian actors have relied almost exclusively on hawala; NRC previously delivered cash via hawala; e-cash costs the same 3% commission.
